# Own-ship reports. Identical payload format, but !AIVDO -- the messages a
# transponder generates about itself rather than ones it received. Note they
# share the "AI" talker, channel A, and sequential id 0 with the type 5 above,
# which is exactly why the reassembler keys on the formatter as well.
